events.what_it_is: A free immersive bodega-themed pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats, with cat-themed photo moments, games and branded experiences.
events.what_is_free: Admission, TEMPTATIONS cat-treat samples, and chances to win exclusive Cat Bodega merchandise through games including a claw machine and scratch-offs.
events.caveats: Free treats and merchandise/prizes are subject to availability. The official brand announcement publishes public visiting hours and does not state an advance RSVP requirement.
events.practical_notes: Open Sept. 17-19 from noon to 6 PM daily at 213 Bowery. This is a public walk-in pop-up; the separate virtual Cat Bodega continues online through Sept. 26.

events.event_name: Bobbi Brown The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 9th Avenue between West 14th and West 15th Streets, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Bobbi Brown newsstand activation introducing Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ with sampling, a mirrored photo moment and giveaway mechanics.
events.what_is_free: Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ samples, grapefruit Spindrift, a mini croissant, and a scratch-off giveaway; select scratch-offs win full-size product.
events.caveats: Giveaway items and full-size prizes are limited/subject to availability. Two current NYC event sources agree on the date, hours, location and free public format; an official Bobbi Brown event page was not located in this pass.
events.practical_notes: Thursday Sept. 17 only, noon-6 PM at Chelsea Triangle on 9th Avenue between 14th and 15th Streets.

events.event_name: CookUnity The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Five locations: 873 Broadway; 266 West 23rd Street; 369 Madison Avenue; 275 West 4th Street; 451 Third Avenue, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A one-day CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas and delis featuring free chef-made meals from eight chefs including Rocco DiSpirito, Vikas Khanna, José Garces, Einat Admony and Andrew Rea/Babish.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary CookUnity meals or hot bites while supplies last, plus a bodega-style scratch-off for chances to win additional CookUnity meals and dining experiences.
events.caveats: Food is explicitly while supplies last; current coverage recommends arriving early. No advance RSVP is stated. This record groups the simultaneous five-location activation as one event rather than duplicating it five times.
events.practical_notes: Thursday Sept. 17, 11:30 AM-2:30 PM. Locations: Bari Bodega, 873 Broadway (Flatiron); Madison Square Deli & Convenience, 266 W 23rd St (Chelsea); New York Pizza and Cafe, 369 Madison Ave (Midtown); Sam's Deli, 275 W 4th St (West Village); Slice N' Spice Deli & Grill, 451 Third Ave (Murray Hill).

events.address: Robert F. Wagner Jr. Park, 20 Battery Place, New York, NY 10280
events.what_it_is: Illumination NYC's fifth annual light-art festival at Wagner Park, with more than 10 light installations, DJs and additional on-site programming.
events.what_is_free: Public admission to the light-art festival and installations.
events.caveats: Food and drinks may be sold separately. Current event listings identify the festival as free; no advance RSVP requirement is published in the verified sources used here.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 17, 18 and 19, 7-11 PM nightly at Wagner Park in Battery Park City.
